name: Console visual redesign — apply
objective: Implement P27's signed design rounds faithfully across the console, graph and document views at phone/tablet/desktop; fix the graph (off-frame default view, id-based node links, anonymous tag bounce, empty-state sizing); add the project document list (project page + graph legend), the chrome-less HTML-only document view, and print-pipeline PDF export; verify in the operator runtime with a real browser.

acceptance.walkthrough:
P28 — operator acceptance walk. Phone, iPad and Mac. Nothing is recorded as passing until you clear this.

WHERE TO RUN IT
The fixtures exist only on this machine, so walk it locally:
  - docker container `kb-p28s2-pg` (up), `uv run uvicorn server.main:app --port 8766` (up),
    `pnpm --dir web dev` -> http://127.0.0.1:3030 (up). All three were left running.
  - Sign in as p28s5@example.com / p28s5-throwaway-pw (throwaway fixture tenant).
  - From the phone/iPad use this Mac's LAN IP instead of 127.0.0.1, or deploy to
    https://knowledge.hi2vi.com first. THE REAL PROOF OF THE GRAPH FIX IS YOUR OWN CORPUS ON
    PRODUCTION — the local p28s6 corpus (33 docs / 100 tags / 136 nodes) is a stand-in shaped
    like yours, not yours.

START WITH WHAT YOU COMPLAINED ABOUT — THE GRAPH, ON YOUR PHONE
1. /@p28s6/graph (no sign-in). The map should sit ENTIRELY INSIDE the plate — small but whole.
   The wires off the frame are gone. Then pinch and double-tap to zoom: NOBODY HAS TESTED TOUCH,
   and this design deliberately drops the +/- buttons on a small plate BECAUSE pinch exists.
   If pinch does not work, say so — that is the one interaction the phase could not verify.
2. The pill row under the map: swipe it sideways. "Tags / 태그 76" carries a small toggle — tap it;
   the 76 tag hubs should vanish and come back. Judge two things: the toggle is 24x13.6 (the
   record's own size) inside a 44px pill — big enough for your thumb? And the row scrolls with no
   hint that it does, so "Unresolved" is off-screen until you swipe.
3. Turn the phone SIDEWAYS on /graph: the plate is 30rem and the Fit control lands ~254px below
   the fold. Acceptable, or should it move?
4. Same three on the iPad and the Mac (/graph signed in): legend instead of the dock at 820+,
   rail at 1024+.

THEN THE REST OF THE CONSOLE, AT EACH SIZE
/dashboard -> /documents (search; project filter; ?limit=10 for the pager) -> a project page
(/projects/... — the Documents panel is new) -> a document (/documents/64) -> "Full width" on it
(Esc exits) -> "Export PDF" (choose Save as PDF; look at the masthead and the colophon on the sheet).

NINE DECISIONS I NEED FROM YOU (these route all 30 questions the phase raised)

1. THE 44px PROMISE vs THE STYLESHEETS. Four controls are deliberately drawn smaller than the
   acceptance prose promises: the phone account avatar (33.6px), the --sm buttons Open / Copy link /
   Revoke (38px), the graph panel close (44x35), the dock toggle (24x13.6). Nothing was "fixed"
   from markup. One ruling: prose wins (a fix slice raises them) or the stylesheets win.

2. VETO OR KEEP THE THREE RECORD CORRECTIONS. All three live in web/src/app/kb-record-fixes.css and
   each reverts by deleting one block. None invents a value; all three restate the record's own
   declarations at a selector the record stranded.
   (a) the documents search box raised to 16px so iOS stops zooming on focus;
   (b) the print masthead/colophon made visible IN PRINT — without it, printed pages carry no
       provenance at all;
   (c) the graph dock's tag toggle given a box — without it, a phone has an invisible tag switch.

3. BLESS THE THREE ORIGINATED VALUES (they came from us, not from a signed round):
   - the 500 page's second line: "The page did not finish loading. Try again — and if it keeps
     failing, the reference below tells us where it stopped."
   - the graph's 11px landmark-label floor. Look at the middle of the map: the eight titles are
     legible now AND THEY OVERLAP in the dense core. The number is adjustable; or lower the
     8-label cap; or turn always-on landmarks off.
   - a 200 ms grace before the explainer asks the relay whether it 404'd.

4. COPY. Every card string was adopted verbatim (round 06 is English-only, round 05 bilingual — say
   if you want round 06 bilingual too). The project documents panel's failure block reuses the 500
   copy whose last clause mentions "the reference below", which a panel never shows. Bless it or
   give the panel its own line.

5. CONFIRM OR REVERT THREE STRUCTURAL CHOICES: the root 500 page renders the designed block WITHOUT
   the console shell (identity itself failed, so there is no org/email for a topbar); three visible
   changes on the mint/create forms that follow the drawn markup (secondary "New key", Copy moved
   beside the key, visible field labels); and the graph's loading state living in the route while
   only a model-build failure renders in the plate.

6. TWO GAPS LEFT OPEN ON PURPOSE: the phone skeleton's card-shaped blocks, and a loading state for
   the public document page. Neither was invented in place. Say the word and each becomes a fix slice.

7. THINGS ONLY YOU, WITH DEVICES, CAN SETTLE:
   - PDF on iOS is Share -> Print -> pinch-to-PDF. Acceptable, or bring server-side PDF (D25) forward?
   - the iOS zoom fix on the real phone.
   - PRINT ONE DOCUMENT FROM SAFARI WITH THE OS IN DARK MODE and say whether the tag chips come out
     grey or teal.
   - on a phone the document's Delete sits one thumb-width from Full width in a four-cell row —
     should it drop to its own row?
   - in full width: the exit pill's safe-area offset, its Esc badge (hidden on touch), and that
     entering the view resets the scroll to the top.

8. THE MEMBER GRAPH'S READ LINK stays /documents/{id}; the public graph uses the pretty
   canonical_path. Following canonical_path on the member side too would send you to the public
   view of your own document. Default stands unless you say otherwise.

9. FRESH EYES — four things the review met as a first-time user, NOT judged against the design record:
   - on a phone the only button in each documents-list row is the red Delete (the title is the read link);
   - turning Tags off does not re-fit the map, so it stays parked in the top half until you press Fit;
   - the dock's side-scroll is unannounced;
   - a framed explainer looks foreign inside the designed page (default blue links, default button)
     because it is a sandboxed opaque-origin frame the console cannot style. Worth a caption?

RECORDED, NO DECISION NEEDED (overrule any if you disagree): D26 is closed; round 03's table-priority
gap was answered by round 04; "seven not-found pages" is six; the trend box's 3.34:1 vs the predicted
3.7:1; two prose overreaches in round 04's own text; the graph's off-map recenter threshold is
unreachable because clampPan already prevents it; round 06's four arithmetic slips; and "printing from
the full-width view is identical" is not literally true (it drops the title block, and the export
control is not reachable there anyway).

EXPLICITLY UNVERIFIED BY ANYONE IN THIS PHASE, SO IT IS YOURS TO JUDGE: all touch interaction
(including pinch / double-tap zoom on a small plate); Safari on Mac and iOS — EVERY ENGINE CLAIM IN
THIS PHASE IS CHROMIUM'S, including the teal-chip question; a physical printer (every paper claim is
a PDF out of the print pipeline); the production origin in the print masthead (locally it prints
127.0.0.1:3030); real devices at DPR > 1; and prefers-reduced-motion live.

WHEN YOU ARE DONE
  pass:  python3 scripts/workflow.py accept-gate P28 --clear --note "..."
  fail:  tell me what broke — it is recorded as
         python3 scripts/workflow.py review-phase P28 --verdict changes_requested --note "operator-reported: ..."
         and becomes fix slices, then a re-review.
